gc: G1 Young Generation+G1 Concurrent GC+G1 Old Generation

environment.lodCounterMeaning: Cumulative encoded main-world terrain, distant subset, replacements and shadows are separate; subtract phase endpoints. Memory samples are not peaks.
environment.memorySampling: Point-in-time after each phase; not a peak or resident-set measurement

readiness.contract: Every chunk in the server tracking footprint received; Fabric light queue and renderer compile queue drained

gpuFrameContract: First GPU start to last GPU end of buffers committed on the render thread inside each frame; includes gaps, never sums overlapping spans; pending/invalid/empty/overflow frames excluded and counted
